sections.text: EWSR1::WT1 is an oncogenic transcriptional regulator of desmoplastic small round cell tumor. Fusion-depletion experiments reduce active chromatin, three-dimensional enhancer contacts and direct target-gene expression; coexpression of its +KTS and −KTS splice isoforms generated DSRCT-like xenografts in a mesothelial-cell model.

audit_evidence.location: Results: EWS-WT1 depletion leads to strong changes in chromatin activity and 3D connectivity; Figures 3, 5 and 6
audit_evidence.scope: Indexed full Results and figure legends: depletion reduces active chromatin and direct target expression; EWS prion-like domain mutants lose binding/activation; coexpression of KTS isoforms generates DSRCT-like xenografts.
